text:
sara-recruiter: Heads-up — we have two contractors flying in next Wed for onsite interviews. Can People Ops advance their flight costs? Need to book by EOD tomorrow.

emma-peopleops: Quick answer — contractors are generally not eligible for advances unless pre-approved for hiring events. We can make an exception but need the formal advance request + procurement ticket.

sara-recruiter: Ok what's the form/process? I can fill it now.

emma-peopleops: Please use the Hiring Travel Advance form (link: https://intranet.redwood/corp/expenses/advances). Key things to include: candidate name, contractor company, estimated total, dates, PO or req number, and business justification.

max-hiringops: Also confirm whether contractors will invoice us or if the agency bills us. If agency bills, we shouldn't need to advance — procurement handles.

jon-finance: +1. If the contractor vendor invoices, route to procurement and attach travel estimate to the PR. If we issue an advance to the contractor employee, we need a vendor record (W-9/COI) and a petty cash check request or ACH setup. Timeline: advances must be reconciled within 5 business days after travel or we deduct from next invoice.

expense-bot: Reminder: company policy for advances — maximum single advance for hiring travel is $1,000 unless VP approval. Receipts required for all expenses, per-diem allowed up to $75/day domestic. See policy: https://intranet.redwood/corp/expenses/policy

emma-peopleops: Copying the exact checklist so you can paste into the form:

```
Advance Request Checklist:
- Requestor name & team
- Contractor name & company
- Business purpose (candidate onsite)
- Estimated total (breakdown: flights, hotel, ground)
- Dates of travel
- PO/Req (if available)
- Approver (Hiring Manager + People Ops)
- Bank details or check mailing address
```

emma-peopleops: Notes on limits and rules: hotel cap $250/night (unless location-specific approval), per-diem $75/day domestic, no reimbursement for alcohol, upgrades (seat class) require prior written approval. If actuals are less than the advance, contractor must return balance; if more, they submit expenses for reimbursement (subject to receipts).

sara-recruiter: Thanks. For the two contractors, estimates are $420 and $360. I'll submit the form and attach the agency contact info. Do we need signatures from the hiring manager?

emma-peopleops: Yes — hiring manager approval required. Please cc max-hiringops on the form so we can speed the procurement side. Once approved, finance will issue ACH within 2 business days.

max-hiringops: I'll open the procurement ticket as soon as I see the form. If agency will invoice, I'll link the PR and call them to confirm billing.

jon-finance: One more — tag expenses with project_code: "hiring-events" and cost_center: "recruiting" when reconciling. That prevents misallocation in month-end close.

sara-recruiter: Filed the form and added the estimates + agency contact. @emma-peopleops can you review when you have a sec?

emma-peopleops: Reviewing now. If approved, we aim to issue $500 each as a ceiling advance to simplify recon. Please remind contractors to keep itemized receipts and submit within 5 business days. :thumbsup:

sara-recruiter: Great — thanks everyone. I'll confirm bookings once funds are sent.

expense-bot: Ticket #ADV-2026-118 created and assigned to emma-peopleops. Deadline to reconcile: 5 business days after travel end.
